Relocate the tag taxonomy to the engine boundary
Define the engine's public data schema (the sources.schema.json contract)
Split the core engine from the Svelte integration
Branch awareness plus the in-progress.json staging pipeline
drift audit verb: mechanical-proxy tier scoring across authored overlays
Migrate the repo package manager from npm to Bun

Rename Drift verbs for clearer intent (update to sync, accept to keep, exclude to hide)
drift author verb: scaffold and open a project overlay
drift pin verb: set pin in a project overlay
drift flag verb: the pin and hide overlay flags under one verb
drift relate verb: write a ProjectRelationship into a project overlay
drift link verb: write a TechRelationship into tech-relationships.ts
Intra-span dormancy signal: sample commit dates so activity gaps become detectable
Improve role detection: richer signals than commit share for the solo/lead/collaborator inference
drift enrich verb: opt-in gh-backed enrichment writing GitHub's own archived repo flag and homepageUrl into a schema-extended sources.json section, while drift sync stays offline
Derive the site's retired and deployed axes from enriched manifest data, replacing the authored placeholders
Audit the Project property surface: no two fields claim the same fact, and every fact worth storing has exactly one home
tasks.notes: Covers SyncedSource, AuthoredProject, Project, ProjectMetrics and the nested Contribution/TechTag/ProjectRelationship shapes. Overlap precedent: deployed is derived from liveUrl presence; progress and released were split because one field made two claims; retired and hide both carried the hero-pool exclusion. Coverage gap already known: activeMonths, spanMonths and maxGapDays are synced but reach no Project field.

tasks.description: Surface the intra-span activity metrics (spanMonthsActive, spanMonthsAll, spanGapMaxDays) so the sustained-vs-bursty signal reaches the site
tasks.notes: Finding F6 of the property census (docs/design/property-census.md). All three are measured by check-drift.js on every sync and persisted for all 33 repos, but nothing in src/ reads them: they are absent from SyncedMetricKey and from every inference function. spanMonthsActive/spanMonthsAll is the sustained-vs-bursty ratio, spanGapMaxDays the longest silence inside the span; together they distinguish a repo worked steadily for eight months from one with two commits eight months apart, which the commitAnyRoot/commitAnyLast endpoint dates cannot. Since F4 the data-layer half is adding the three keys to SyncedMetricKey and the withSyncedMetrics gate; the rest is choosing a presentation (a MetricsPanel row, or a timeline visual).

milestones.name: Aesthetics: Ongoing
milestones.goal: The standing home for aesthetic work after the visual direction settled in M3: refinements to how the site and its generated artefacts look, taken up once the functional milestones they depend on have landed.

tasks.description: Spike: investigate enhancements to the procedural OG card generation, and record the options with a recommendation
tasks.notes: Supersedes the parked "Generative OG variants per theme" idea, which was one avenue among several. src/lib/og/card.ts derives each card from project data, but keys its motif on runtime alone via runtimeArchetype(), so 23 of 33 projects collapse into two archetypes (bun 12, node 11) and 5 fall through to the generic dot. Avenues to weigh: widening the archetype signal beyond runtime; theme-driven variants (themes currently feed nothing in card.ts); using signal the card already receives and ignores (kind, track, role, tags, lineage); and the motif mechanics themselves (one fixed 132px tiling, hash-seeded rotation and phase). Output is a written comparison with a recommendation, not an implementation; follow-up tasks land after it is read.
